title: Getting a local recommendation
objectives: Ask if a seat is free and start a conversation
Say when you arrived and share a first impression
Ask a follow-up about a recommended place

courseTemplate.setting: The local recommends the riverside market early in the morning, before the crowds.
courseTemplate.openingLine: Hi there! Are you looking for a seat?

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes, I arrived yesterday. I love the city so far.
targetPatterns.example: Yes, I arrived yesterday. I love the city so far.

targetPatterns.pattern: Not yet. Is it worth visiting, and when should I go?
targetPatterns.example: Not yet. Is it worth visiting, and when should I go?

targetPatterns.pattern: What food is this area famous for?
targetPatterns.example: What food is this area famous for?
targetPatterns.translation: 这一带以什么食物出名？
这附近有什么宝藏去处？

targetPatterns.pattern: How do you say this in English?
targetPatterns.example: How do you say this in English?

targetPatterns.pattern: What's the one thing I shouldn't miss here?
targetPatterns.example: What's the one thing I shouldn't miss here?
targetPatterns.translation: 这里最不能错过的是什么？

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you recommend a place locals actually go?
targetPatterns.example: Could you recommend a place locals actually go?
targetPatterns.translation: 有什么本地人真会去的地方推荐吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: It was really nice talking to you.
targetPatterns.example: It was really nice talking to you.

stages.title: Ask if a seat is free and start a conversation
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hi there! Are you looking for a seat?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask if a seat is free and start a conversation in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, is this seat …”

stages.title: Say when you arrived and share a first impression
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Go ahead! Is it your first time here?”
successCriteria: The learner can say when you arrived and share a first impression in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, I arrived yesterday. …”

stages.title: Ask a follow-up about a recommended place
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Have you been to the riverside market yet?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask a follow-up about a recommended place in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Not yet. Is it …”

languageNotes: 破冰别用 "What's your name?" 开场（对成年人显得突兀），从环境切入（天气、食物、景色）更自然；「改天见」See you around 比 "bye bye" 地道。
